Use case: stylized-concept. NEW KFB cartoon claymation ink blob STORY TRIOS. ONE landscape1536x1024 TRUE TRANSPARENT PNG, EXACTLY THREE columns TWO rows=SIX DIFFERENT standalone CHARACTERS. Top row THREE different individuals in ONE trio; bottom row THREE DIFFERENT individuals in a SECOND trio. THIS IS NOT A TIER/CAREER/EMOTION progression. Never repeat one identity across row. Three means a crowd: each row belongs together by restrained costume/material motif and complementary personality, but each actor must function independently outside group. No handoffs, pointing at neighbour, overlaps or shared objects.
Reference image1 ORIGINAL freche-family for whole dark INK morphology/material; image2 ORIGINAL props reference for modeling craft only. STYLE REFERENCES, NOT edit targets or character templates. No likenesses of actors/musicians, no film still reconstruction, all are ORIGINAL grotesque ink blobs.
FAMILY INVARIANTS: complete UPRIGHT FOOTLESS charcoal/deep-violet rounded ink SPLATS with thick soft asymmetrical goo lobes, subtle violet sheen, tactile modeled plasticine/fingerprints, sculpted lids/lips and uneven ivory teeth. Hands are goo continuous with body. No humanoid torso/legs/feet/busts, no whole coats/robes hiding goo. Dark ink face/body dominant, accessories small and readable. Every OPEN eye has WHITE/ivory sclera surrounding separate RED iris and BLACK pupil. Planned cyclops has same colour rule. No all-red/glowing eyeballs. Offbeat absurd/surreal satirical peak acting, not generic cute Pixar babies, no repeated V-brow tooth grin. Differentiate body contour, eye/lid shapes, mouth, posture and temperament BEFORE props. Some mouths closed, some open, unequal gazes; NO protruding tongue in ANY cell.
LAYOUT: equal512x512 cells, each ENTIRE actor and all own droplets/props inside MAX384x384 box with64px transparent margins ALL sides. Centres(256,256),(768,256),(1280,256),(256,768),(768,768),(1280,768). Never cross x512,x1024,y512. Similar overall body size, no giant boss. Few bold simple functional handmade props, rich softly rounded wood/metal/cloth, not machinery clutter. Entire figure isolated, no floor/cast shadows/scenelet/scenery/extra heads.

TOP ROW TRIO: Drei gegen die Stille. Context: Original jazz trio; no named musicians or likeness references. SHARED restrained belonging cue: tiny midnight-blue collars, little COPPER oval pins and one restrained CORAL cloth accent each.
LEFT: A DIFFERENT FEMALE-READ jazz saxophonist. TALL curving upright ink pear, high flowing crown quiff, long lids/lashes, TWO offset ivory upper teeth. One eye blissfully shut and one sideways, strong curved closed lip. Holds ONE short beautifully rounded BRASS SAXOPHONE with thick curved bell and THREE large keys at own belly, mouthpiece clear of face.
MIDDLE: A DIFFERENT male double-bass anchor. VERY WIDE low heavy upright ink splat, three blunt crown lobes, single big lower tusk. Low patient half-lids, CLOSED solemn downturned lip. Hugs ONE compact fat WOODEN DOUBLE BASS with short neck and THREE thick strings, entire instrument at belly with NO endpin/floor, goo face/body dominant.
RIGHT: A DIFFERENT male impatient snare drummer. SMALL narrow tilted upright goo bean, one springy crown hook, FOUR tiny irregular upper teeth. Both WHITE/red/black eyes wide and asymmetric, delighted sideways clenched-tooth grin. ONE small copper-rimmed SNARE DRUM strapped LOW to own belly, ONE short fat wooden stick in each goo hand, no kit/stool.

BOTTOM ROW TRIO: Die angekündigte Ruhestörung. Context: Original garage-punk trio; no celebrity likenesses. SHARED restrained belonging cue: small worn plum collars with a MUSTARD stitch and tiny dull-copper hardware, no leather human torsos.
LEFT: A DIFFERENT FEMALE-READ garage singer. BROAD upright triangular ink splat, THREE thick crown waves like soft goo mohawk, lashes, TWO big uneven lower teeth. Defiant furious OPEN underbite SHOUT, one eye squeezed, no tongue. Holds ONE fat old black MICROPHONE with copper stem at belly, no stand or cable.
MIDDLE: A DIFFERENT male obsessive guitarist. TALL thin stooping-but-UPRIGHT bean, long drooping crown lobe, ONE off-centre upper ivory fang. Suspicious concentrated crosswise gaze, CLOSED lip biting tooth. Hugs ONE short rounded battered mustard ELECTRIC GUITAR with plum pickguard and THREE fat strings, no amp/cables.
RIGHT: A DIFFERENT male bucket percussionist. VERY ROUND low upright ink dumpling, TWO tiny side crown nubs, large soft lower lip and THREE sparse upper teeth. Enormous delighted open tooth LAUGH, one eye shut, NO tongue. Holds ONE dented upside-down steel BUCKET as a small belly drum, ONE short fat wooden kitchen spoon for striking, no floor.
EMPTY BACKGROUND AND HOLES ACTUAL ALPHA0, interiors opaque with soft antialiased outer edge only. No gradient/matte/checkerboard/floor/shadowdiscs, no lettering/numbers/logos/labels/borders or floating punctuation. Six complete distinct characters, two coherent TRIOS, exactly TWO female-read figures in sheet. Body/face individuality first; group relationship second; simple iconic props third.
